title: Scenic Half-Day Kayak or Paddleboard Rental – Dora Canal
includes: Map and route recommendations before departure
Choice of single kayak, tandem kayak, or stand-up paddleboard
Basic paddling instruction and safety briefing
Staff assistance with launching and landing
Paddle and all required safety equipment
Dry bags or waterproof phone cases (available for purchase) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
For safety, weight limits are: single kayak up to 300 lbs, tandem kayak up to 500 lbs combined, and stand-up paddleboard up to 225 lbs.
Weight information is requested at booking to ensure proper equipment selection.
policies: Alcohol and smoking are not permitted during this activity.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Dora Canal offers one of the most scenic and peaceful paddling experiences in Central Florida, with calm water, abundant wildlife, and a shaded canopy of towering cypress trees draped in Spanish moss. Unlike many launches that require a long paddle to reach scenic areas, our waterfront location provides quick and easy access to the canal, allowing you to spend more time enjoying the scenery. After your paddle, you’re just steps away from the waterfront park, restaurants, and seaplane activity that make downtown Tavares a unique destination.

What sets this experience apart:
• Direct and easy access to the famous Dora Canal
• Calm, beginner-friendly water and relaxed paddling
• Frequent wildlife sightings in a natural setting
• Scenic cypress canopy and authentic Old Florida atmosphere
• Waterfront location in walkable downtown Tavares
